::: {.callout-important title="Start here, or continue from the previous section" collapse="false"}

You can arrive at this section in two ways.

**Continuing from [Genotyping quality control](../01B_genotyping_qc/01B_genotyping_qc.qmd).**
Everything you need is already in `results/`. Skip to Step 01.

**Starting here.** Download the genotype checkpoint from the
[release page](https://github.com/mgentiluomo/how-to-gwas-pdac/releases) into
`checkpoints/`, then run the check below. It takes a few seconds and it is not
optional: it is what tells you that your files came from the same pipeline that
produced the figures on this page.

:::

## Before you start: check your entry point

```{r}
#| eval: false

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Entry check.
#
# A checkpoint is an opaque binary. If it came from an older version of the
# pipeline, nothing in it will look wrong, and every number you compute from
# here on will quietly fail to match the pages. This function is the only
# defence, so run it.
#
# It compares what you have against the manifest shipped with the bundle, and
# then prints the counts this section expects.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

check_entry <- function(dir = "checkpoints", expected = list()) {

  man_path <- file.path(dir, "MANIFEST.tsv")
  if (!file.exists(man_path))
    stop("No MANIFEST.tsv in ", dir,
         ". Download the whole bundle, not individual files.")

  man <- read.delim(man_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  # Checksums are taken on decompressed content, so a different gzip version
  # on your machine cannot make a good file look bad.
  content_md5 <- function(f) {
    if (grepl("\\.gz$", f)) {
      con <- gzfile(f, "rb")
      raw_bytes <- readBin(con, "raw", file.size(f) * 20)
      close(con)
      tmp <- tempfile(); writeBin(raw_bytes, tmp)
      on.exit(unlink(tmp), add = TRUE)
      tools::md5sum(tmp)[[1]]
    } else {
      tools::md5sum(f)[[1]]
    }
  }

  ok <- TRUE
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(man))) {
    f <- file.path(dir, man$file[i])
    if (!file.exists(f)) { message("  MISSING  ", man$file[i]); ok <- FALSE; next }
    if (identical(unname(content_md5(f)), man$content_md5[i])) {
      message("  ok       ", man$file[i])
    } else {
      message("  MISMATCH ", man$file[i]); ok <- FALSE
    }
  }

  if (!ok)
    stop("The bundle does not match its manifest. Download it again; do not ",
         "continue, because the numbers on this page will not reproduce.")

  # Second, independent check: the counts this section is written around.
  message("")
  for (nm in names(expected)) {
    got <- expected[[nm]]$got()
    want <- expected[[nm]]$want
    flag <- if (identical(got, want)) "ok" else "DIFFERS"
    message(sprintf("  %-8s %-34s %s (expected %s)", flag, nm, got, want))
    if (!identical(got, want)) ok <- FALSE
  }

  if (!ok)
    stop("Your checkpoint is internally consistent but comes from a different ",
         "version of the pipeline than this page describes.")

  message("\nEntry check passed. Continue to Step 01.")
  invisible(TRUE)
}


# --- what THIS section expects ---------------------------------------------
# Only this block changes from one section to another.

check_entry(
  dir = "checkpoints",
  expected = list(
    "samples after QC"  = list(want = 1217L,
                               got  = function() length(readLines("checkpoints/pdac_demo_qc.fam"))),
    "variants after QC" = list(want = 414695L,
                               got  = function() length(readLines("checkpoints/pdac_demo_qc.bim")))
  )
)
```

```
#> ok       pdac_demo_qc.bed
#> ok       pdac_demo_qc.bim
#> ok       pdac_demo_qc.fam
#> ...
#>
#> ok       samples after QC                   1217 (expected 1217)
#> ok       variants after QC                  414695 (expected 414695)
#>
#> Entry check passed. Continue to Step 01.
```

## Valori attesi per ciascuna sezione

Da sostituire nel blocco `expected` a seconda della pagina.

**Sezione 2, population stratification** e **Sezione 03B, statistical power**

```r
"samples after QC"  = list(want = 1217L,   got = function() length(readLines("checkpoints/pdac_demo_qc.fam"))),
"variants after QC" = list(want = 414695L, got = function() length(readLines("checkpoints/pdac_demo_qc.bim")))
```

**Sezione 4A, association testing** — serve anche il set di analisi

```r
"samples after QC"     = list(want = 1217L,   got = function() length(readLines("checkpoints/pdac_demo_qc.fam"))),
"variants after QC"    = list(want = 414695L, got = function() length(readLines("checkpoints/pdac_demo_qc.bim"))),
"European analysis set"= list(want = 611L,    got = function() length(readLines("checkpoints/pdac_demo_eur_keep.txt")))
```

**Sezioni 5 e 6, meta-analisi e fine mapping** — nessun genotipo

```r
"variants with a P value" = list(
   want = 405020L,
   got  = function() {
     d <- read.delim(gzfile("checkpoints/pdac_demo_gwas_eur.tsv.gz"), check.names = FALSE)
     sum(d$TEST == "ADD" & is.finite(as.numeric(d$P)))
   })
```

::: {.callout-note title="Perche' due controlli e non uno"}
Il checksum dice che il file e' arrivato integro. I conteggi dicono che e' il
file **giusto**: un bundle di una versione precedente della pipeline supera il
primo controllo e fallisce il secondo, ed e' esattamente il caso che rovina il
lavoro di chi entra a meta' strada senza accorgersene.
:::
